output.sql:
SELECT 
    t.name AS track_name,
    a.name AS artist_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playlist_id) AS playlist_count
FROM 
    track t
JOIN 
    album al ON t.album_id = al.album_id
JOIN 
    artist a ON al.artist_id = a.artist_id
JOIN 
    playlist_track pt ON t.track_id = pt.track_id
GROUP BY 
    t.track_id, t.name, a.name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT pt.playlist_id) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    playlist_count DESC, 
    t.name ASC
